hamzat_wasl.label: Hamzat al-waṣl
hamzat_wasl.desc: Connecting hamza: pronounced only when starting from this word, silent when joined to what comes before.

lam_shamsiyyah.label: Lām shamsiyyah
lam_shamsiyyah.desc: The lām of "al-" is not pronounced; it merges into the following "sun letter", which is doubled.

silent.label: Silent letter
silent.desc: Written but not pronounced in recitation.

madd_246.label: Madd ʿāriḍ / līn (2, 4, 6)
madd_246.desc: Prolongation of 2, 4 or 6 counts when stopping on the word.

madd_munfasil.label: Madd munfaṣil (4–5)
madd_munfasil.desc: Separated madd: a madd letter at the end of a word followed by a hamza at the start of the next; 4–5 counts.

madd_muttasil.label: Madd muttaṣil (4–5)
madd_muttasil.desc: Connected madd: a madd letter followed by a hamza in the same word; 4–5 counts.

ghunnah.label: Ghunnah
ghunnah.desc: Nasalisation held for about 2 counts, typically on a doubled nūn or mīm.

ikhfa.label: Ikhfāʾ
ikhfa.desc: Nūn sākinah or tanwīn is partially hidden, with ghunnah, before one of the 15 ikhfāʾ letters.

ikhfa_shafawi.label: Ikhfāʾ shafawī
ikhfa_shafawi.desc: Mīm sākinah is hidden, with ghunnah, before bāʾ.

idghaam_ghunnah.label: Idghām with ghunnah
idghaam_ghunnah.desc: Nūn sākinah or tanwīn merges into the next letter (ي ن م و) with ghunnah.

idghaam_no_ghunnah.label: Idghām without ghunnah
idghaam_no_ghunnah.desc: Nūn sākinah or tanwīn merges into the next letter (ل ر) without ghunnah.

idghaam_shafawi.label: Idghām shafawī
idghaam_shafawi.desc: Mīm sākinah merges into a following mīm, with ghunnah.

idghaam_mutajanisayn.label: Idghām mutajānisayn
idghaam_mutajanisayn.desc: Merging of two letters that share a point of articulation but differ in qualities.

idghaam_mutaqaribayn.label: Idghām mutaqāribayn
idghaam_mutaqaribayn.desc: Merging of two letters that are close in articulation and qualities.

iqlab.label: Iqlāb
iqlab.desc: Nūn sākinah or tanwīn becomes a hidden mīm, with ghunnah, before bāʾ.

qalqalah.label: Qalqalah
qalqalah.desc: An echoing bounce on a sākin ق ط ب ج د.
